entities.summary: Brian Skinner is an American former professional basketball player. A 6'9", 255 lb power forward-center from Baylor University, Skinner was selected by the Los Angeles Clippers in the first round of the 1998 NBA draft. He played for the Clippers, Cleveland Cavaliers, Philadelphia 76ers, Milwaukee Bucks, Sacramento Kings, Portland Trail Blazers, Phoenix Suns and Memphis Grizzlies in the NBA, as well as the Italian team Benetton Treviso.
